title: The Last Dinner Party · Knocking at the Sky
description: Intimate portraits, a teal car, a retro broadcast intermission, a violet band stage and a ruby bedroom. The full reference clock drives the physical lead and backing voices.

parts.name: Lead singer
parts.role: Verses, refrain and wordless vocal melody

melody.name: Lead singer
melody.lyrics: Standing on the windowsill Walking in your sleep On the streets, sirens sang For you to take the leap. Thought that you were Icarus Or at least that you were Greek To the people down below You're just another freak. I would give my eyes away just to be the light. I'd burn off my fingerprints, start a brand new life. I would trade my innocence, choke upon my pride. You can find me every night knocking at the sky. Singing la la la la Singing la la la la Singing la la la la Singing la la la la Ah Women wept when you were gone Lay naked on the shore. A hero's death in chiffon trenches Who could ask for more? And you would seek the mountains Or the moon where snow is born To gaze upon the hydra And Athena in softcore. I would give my eyes away Just to be the light. I'd burn off my fingerprints Start a brand new life. I would trade my innocence Choke upon my pride. You can find me every night Knocking at the sky. Singing la la la la Singing la la la la Singing la la la la Singing la la la la Ah La la la la Ah Ah Ah The Horror on Sunset. Ah Honey, there's a seven-car pile-up On the highway to my heart. And if I give you the green light You promise you'll never come back? You promise? Oh, I rue the day I ever left this place. I gave my headshots in To Trashy's Lingerie. I want my MTV My grass and my valet. Ah It never rains on me Oh God, I love L.A. La la la la La la la la La la la la La la la la La la la la La la la la Ah Ah Hmm Ah Hmm
